title: Autopilot profile makes the user a local administrator

report.title: {Items.Count} Autopilot {Plural(Items.Count, 'profile makes', 'profiles make')} the user a local administrator

messages.businessImpact: Every device provisioned by these profiles hands its user administrative rights, regardless of what the directory settings say.
messages.technicalDetail: The Entra device setting governs manual joins only. For Autopilot, the profile's user account type decides, so a tenant can look correct in one place and not the other.
remediation: Set the user account type to Standard on each profile listed.
Provide elevation through a named process for the cases that need it.
messages.cannotSee: Only the account type the profile sets is read. Whether a configuration or endpoint security policy afterwards removes the user from the administrators group, which is a common pairing, is not visible to this rule.
